2. This is an application for pre-arrest bail in connection with CR No.314 of 2023 registered with Faujdar Chawadi Police Station for the offences punishable under Sections 328, 188, 272 and 273 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 ("the Penal Code") and Sections 26(2)(i), 26(2)(ii), 26(2)(iv) read with Section 27(3) (E), 30(2)(A), 59 of The Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
3. Pursuant to information, the Food Safety Officer accompanied by the police personnel conducted a raid at the godown of one Mallinath Katare.
Accused No.1 Ganesh Katare was found therein in possession of the contraband articles 29-ABA2373-2023.DOC worth Rs.4,88,037/-.
4. The learned Counsel for the applicant submitted that there is no material to establish the nexus between the applicant and contraband articles.
opennyai_summary.23_August_2023__decision:
6. Stand over to 13th September, 2023.
7.
In the meanwhile, in the event of arrest of the applicant in CR No.314 of 2023 registered with Faujdar Chawadi Police Station, he be released on bail on furnishing a PR Bond in the sum of Rs.30,000/- with one or two sureties in the like amount.
8. The applicant shall attend Faujdar Chawady Police Station on every Sunday in between 10.00 am.
to 12.00 noon till the next date and cooperate with the investigation.
9. The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence and/or give threat or inducement to any of the person acquainted with the facts of the case.
